name: prove-it
description: The prove-it skill: settle claims about code behavior by running an experiment instead of asserting harder.

plugins.name: prove-it
plugins.description: Classify a claim about how code or a system behaves, then settle it: run a minimal experiment against the real library when it can be run from here, mark it Untested when the experiment is real but out of reach (cost, scale, access), or Ill-posed when no observation could settle it — and report the result even when it refutes the claim.
